Human unfamiliarity, assumptions about moved tests and later uplift/failure reports are preserved, without claiming runtime verification.",
        "The moved update test filters interactedWith using ({ id }), while markAsInteractedWith stores scalar string IDs. That filter sees undefined for each normal string ID and can return [] without testing the intended stored-ID relation. Fixed test_builtinIdsStay explicitly preserves bundled IDs across an empty feed update; the update implementation intersects stored IDs with the union of feed and bundled IDs. A proposed assertion correction must compare scalar IDs and distinguish retained bundled IDs from removed mock IDs. This is a static assertion gap, not an observed intermittent cause, applied fix or instruction to clear all interaction state."
